grow.content:
## 🌟 Declare Your Faith Every Morning!

Every morning, we should remind ourselves what we stand for and who we follow. The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) taught us a beautiful dua that declares our commitment to Islam!

### 📖 The Powerful Morning Declaration:

**Arabic:**
أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا، وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ

**Transliteration:**
Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala deeni nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wasallam, wa 'ala millati abeena Ibraheema haneefan musliman, wama kana minal-mushrikeen

**Translation:**
We have reached the morning upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him), and upon the religion of our forefather Ibrahim, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah

### 💡 Understanding This Powerful Dua:

This beautiful dua has FIVE important declarations:

**1. "Upon the fitrah of Islam"** 🌟
- Fitrah = the natural way humans were created
- Every baby is born with fitrah - knowing Allah exists!
- Islam matches our natural fitrah perfectly
- We're saying: "I'm staying on the natural, pure way!"

**2. "Upon the word of pure faith"** 💚
- The word of pure faith = "La ilaha illallah" (There is no god but Allah)
- This is the foundation of our faith!
- We're declaring: "I believe in Allah alone!"

**3. "Upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad"** ✨
- We follow the Prophet's teachings
- We love his example
- We're declaring: "Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) is my role model!"

**4. "Upon the religion of our forefather Ibrahim"** 🕋
- Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) was a great believer
- He broke idols and worshipped only Allah
- He was "haneef" - one who turns away from falsehood to truth
- We're declaring: "I follow the pure monotheism of Ibrahim!"

**5. "He was not of those who associate others with Allah"** 🚫
- Shirk = associating partners with Allah
- This is the BIGGEST sin
- We're declaring: "I worship ONLY Allah!"

### 🤔 Why Say This Every Morning?

Because every morning you're making a declaration:
- "Today, I'm a Muslim!"
- "Today, I follow Islam!"
- "Today, I worship only Allah!"
- "Today, I follow the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him)!"

It's like renewing your commitment to Islam every single day! 💪

### 🌅 Morning Version vs. Evening Version:

**Morning:** "Asbahna" (We have reached the morning...)
**Evening:** "Amsayna" (We have reached the evening...)

Same beautiful words, just change the beginning! 🌙

### 🎯 Breaking Down the Beautiful Names:

**Ibrahim "Haneefan Musliman":**
- Haneef = One who turns away from all falsehood toward the truth
- Muslim = One who submits to Allah

Prophet Ibrahim destroyed idols! He stood up for Tawheed (believing in One Allah)! We're saying we follow his example! 🌟

### 💪 What Does Fitrah Mean?

Fitrah is the natural way Allah created humans:
- Babies know Allah exists (even before being taught!)
- Humans naturally want to worship
- Islam is the religion that matches this natural way
- Following Islam = following your natural instinct!

When you say "Asbahna 'ala fitratil-Islam," you're saying: "I'm staying on the natural, pure path Allah created me for!" 💚

### 🕌 When to Say It:

🌅 **Morning:** After Fajr or when you wake up
🌙 **Evening:** After Maghrib or before you sleep

### 🌟 Why Include Prophet Ibrahim?

You might wonder: "Why mention Ibrahim when we follow Muhammad?"

Because:
- Prophet Ibrahim is the father of monotheism
- He firmly stood against shirk
- Even Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) followed the pure faith of Ibrahim
- The Ka'bah was built by Ibrahim!
- His story inspires us to be brave for our faith!

We're connecting ourselves to a long line of believers! 🕋

### 🎮 Understanding Shirk:

"Wama kana minal-mushrikeen" (He was not of those who associate others with Allah)

Shirk means:
- Worshipping idols ❌
- Asking dead people for help instead of Allah ❌
- Believing in multiple gods ❌
- Thinking anyone has power like Allah ❌

We're declaring: "I'm free from all of this! I worship ONLY Allah!" ✅

### 🌈 The Five Pillars of This Dua:

1. **Fitrah** - Natural way of Islam
2. **Tawheed** - Pure faith in Allah alone
3. **Following Prophet Muhammad** - Our guide
4. **Following Prophet Ibrahim** - Pure monotheism
5. **Rejecting shirk** - No partners with Allah

All in one powerful dua! 🌟

### 💡 Daily Reminder:

This dua is like a daily alarm:
- "Don't forget who you are!"
- "Don't forget your purpose!"
- "Don't forget your faith!"
- "Stay strong on Islam!"

### 🎯 For Older Kids:

When you say this dua, think about:
- Are you living according to Islam today?
- Are you following the Prophet's example?
- Are you avoiding shirk?
- Are you keeping your faith pure?

It's a daily self-check! ✅

### 🌟 Beautiful Chain of Prophets:

This dua connects you to:
- Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) - The breaker of idols
- Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) - The final messenger
- All the prophets in between!

You're part of this beautiful chain of believers! 💚

### 💙 Amazing Benefits:

✨ Renew your commitment to Islam daily
✨ Remember your identity as a Muslim
✨ Connect to Prophet Muhammad and Prophet Ibrahim
✨ Declare Tawheed (pure monotheism)
✨ Reject shirk firmly
✨ Stay on the fitrah (natural way)
✨ Start/end your day with faith declared
✨ Strengthen your Islamic identity

### 📚 Remember:

Every morning and evening, take a moment to declare: "I'm a Muslim! I follow Islam! I worship only Allah! I follow the Prophets!" Make this your daily declaration and watch how it strengthens your faith and identity! 🌟

> **Parents:** This dua is excellent for teaching children about their Islamic identity and the concept of pure monotheism. Discuss with them what fitrah means and how Islam aligns with our natural state.

**📚 Reference:** *Musnad Ahmad (Graded Authentic)*

grow.title: 🔟 The Simple 10-10-10 After Every Prayer!
grow.content:
## 🌟 Three Simple Phrases, HUGE Rewards!

Did you know there's a super easy dhikr you can do after EVERY prayer that takes less than one minute? The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) taught us to say three beautiful phrases - each one 10 times!

### 📖 The Three Beautiful Phrases:

**1. Tasbih:**
**Arabic:** سُبْحَانَ اللهِ
**Transliteration:** Subhan Allah
**Translation:** Glory be to Allah
**How many times?** 10 times

**2. Tahmid:**
**Arabic:** الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ
**Transliteration:** Alhamdulillah
**Translation:** All praise is for Allah
**How many times?** 10 times

**3. Takbir:**
**Arabic:** اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
**Transliteration:** Allahu Akbar
**Translation:** Allah is the Greatest
**How many times?** 10 times

**Total:** 30 times of beautiful dhikr in less than 1 minute! ⏰

### 📚 From the Prophet's Teaching:

It was narrated that the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) taught his companions to say:
- Subhan Allah 10 times
- Alhamdulillah 10 times
- Allahu Akbar 10 times

After every prayer! 🕌

### 💡 What Do These Words Mean?

**Subhan Allah (Glory be to Allah):**
- Allah is PERFECT
- Allah has NO faults
- Allah is FREE from any imperfection
- When you say this, you're saying "Allah is above everything!" ✨

**Alhamdulillah (All praise is for Allah):**
- We THANK Allah
- We PRAISE Allah
- Everything good comes from Allah
- When you say this, you're being GRATEFUL! 💚

**Allahu Akbar (Allah is the Greatest):**
- Allah is BIGGER than everything
- Allah is MORE POWERFUL than everything
- Allah is GREATER than everything
- When you say this, you're saying "Nothing is greater than Allah!" 💪

### 🌟 Why These Three Specifically?

Because together they cover everything:

1. **Subhan Allah** - Describes what Allah is FREE from (imperfections)
2. **Alhamdulillah** - Describes what we OWE Allah (thanks and praise)
3. **Allahu Akbar** - Describes Allah's GREATNESS (above all)

It's like a complete package of remembrance! 📦

### 🕌 When to Say Them:

After EVERY obligatory prayer:
- Fajr ✅
- Dhuhr ✅
- Asr ✅
- Maghrib ✅
- Isha ✅

That's 5 times a day × 30 dhikr = **150 times of remembering Allah daily!** 🌟

### 💪 The Easy Routine:

After you finish your prayer and say salam:

1. **Stay sitting** on your prayer mat (don't rush off!)
2. **Say Astaghfirullah** 3 times (ask for forgiveness)
3. **Say these 10-10-10:**
   - Subhan Allah × 10
   - Alhamdulillah × 10
   - Allahu Akbar × 10
4. **Recite Ayat al-Kursi** (if you know it)
5. **Make your personal duas** 🤲

### 🌈 Why Is This So Easy?

**Super Short:**
- Just 3 words (repeated 10 times each)
- You already know these words!

**Takes Almost No Time:**
- Less than 1 minute
- Just stay on your prayer mat a bit longer

**HUGE Rewards:**
- 150 times daily of remembering Allah
- Following the Prophet's sunnah
- Multiplying your good deeds!

### 🎮 Make It Fun:

Create a game with your siblings:
- Who can say them most clearly?
- Who can focus the best while saying them?
- Help each other remember after every prayer!

### 💎 The Extended Version:

Some scholars mentioned doing 33-33-33 (total 99) instead:
- Subhan Allah × 33
- Alhamdulillah × 33
- Allahu Akbar × 34 (to complete 100 with La ilaha illallah)

But the 10-10-10 is perfect for kids and beginners! 🌟

### 🌟 What Happens in Your Heart:

When you say these after prayer:

**After "Subhan Allah":** Your heart feels Allah's perfection
**After "Alhamdulillah":** Your heart feels grateful
**After "Allahu Akbar":** Your heart feels Allah's greatness

**Result:** You leave your prayer with your heart FULL of Allah's remembrance! 💚

### 💡 For Different Ages:

**Little Kids (5-7):**
Just do 5-5-5 (5 times each) - that's perfect!

**Older Kids (8-12):**
Do the full 10-10-10 - you got this!

**Teenagers & Adults:**
Can do 33-33-34 if you want extra rewards!

### 🎯 Life Lessons from These Dhikr:

**Subhan Allah teaches:** Humility - Allah is perfect, we're not
**Alhamdulillah teaches:** Gratitude - Thank Allah for everything
**Allahu Akbar teaches:** Perspective - Allah is bigger than all our problems!

### 🕌 The Prophetic Way:

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) used his fingers to count! 👆

He said: "Count on your fingers, for they will be questioned and made to speak."

So using your fingers for dhikr is actually SUNNAH! ✨

### 💙 Amazing Benefits:

✨ Following the Prophet's exact teaching
✨ Only takes 30 seconds to 1 minute
✨ Multiplies your prayer rewards
✨ Keeps you in remembrance of Allah
✨ Easy enough for kids
✨ Can be done anywhere, anytime
✨ 150+ times of dhikr daily automatically!
✨ Prevents you from rushing out of prayer

### 🌟 Quick Formula:

**Every Prayer:**
1. Pray with focus ✅
2. Say salam ✅
3. Ask forgiveness (Astaghfirullah × 3) ✅
4. Do your 10-10-10 dhikr ✅
5. Make dua ✅

**That's the complete post-prayer routine!** 🎯

### 📊 Let's Do the Math:

**Daily:**
5 prayers × 30 dhikr = 150 times

**Weekly:**
150 × 7 days = 1,050 times

**Monthly:**
1,050 × 4 weeks = 4,200 times

**Yearly:**
4,200 × 12 months = **50,400 times of remembering Allah!**

Just from this simple post-prayer dhikr! MashaAllah! 🌟

### 💙 Remember:

Don't rush away from your prayer! Take just ONE more minute to say these beautiful words. It's so easy, so quick, and the rewards are HUGE! Make it a habit after every single prayer, and watch how it transforms your day! 🌟

> **Parents:** Help your children develop this beautiful habit of staying on the prayer mat after salah to do their dhikr. It teaches them mindfulness and prevents the rush-and-forget mentality. Start with smaller numbers if needed!

**📚 References:**
- *Sahih Muslim 595*
- *Sunan Abu Dawud 1503*
- *Sunan at-Tirmidhi 3410*

grow.title: 😴 The Last Words Before You Sleep!
grow.content:
## 🌟 What to Say When You Go to Bed!

Just like we have a special dua when we wake up, we have a beautiful dua to say right before we sleep! The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) never went to sleep without saying these words!

### 📖 The Beautiful Bedtime Dua:

**Arabic:**
بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا

**Transliteration:**
Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya

**Translation:**
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live

### 📚 The Prophet's Bedtime Routine:

Hudhaifah (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that when the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) wanted to go to sleep, he would place his right hand under his right cheek and say this beautiful dua.

Imagine - the last words the Prophet spoke before sleeping were to put himself in Allah's care! 💚

### 💡 Understanding This Short But Deep Dua:

**"Bismika"** - In Your name
- I'm doing this in Allah's name
- I'm under Allah's protection
- I start everything with Allah's name

**"Allahumma"** - O Allah
- We're calling upon Allah
- We're talking directly to our Creator

**"Amutu"** - I die
- Sleep is like a small death (remember?)
- We "die" every night when we sleep
- Our souls go to Allah

**"Wa ahya"** - And I live
- If Allah wills, we'll wake up (live again)
- Not everyone who sleeps wakes up
- Life and death are in Allah's hands

### 🤔 Wait... "I Die and I Live"?!

Yes! This dua teaches us something deep:

**When you go to sleep:**
- It's like a mini-death
- Your consciousness leaves
- You're helpless and unaware
- Allah takes your soul temporarily

**If Allah wills, you wake up:**
- It's like being brought back to life
- Your soul returns
- You become aware again
- You can move and think

So every night = a small death
Every morning = a small resurrection! 🌟

### 🌙 The Complete Bedtime Sunnah:

The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) had a beautiful routine:

**1. Place right hand under right cheek** 🖐️
- Lie on your right side
- Put your right hand under your right cheek
- This is the sunnah sleeping position!

**2. Say the dua:** "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya"

**3. Recite:**
- Surah Al-Ikhlas (3 times)
- Surah Al-Falaq (3 times)
- Surah An-Nas (3 times)
- Blow into your hands and wipe over your body

**4. Trust Allah and sleep peacefully!** 😴

### 💭 Why This Dua is So Powerful:

**It teaches us:**
1. **Submission** - We put ourselves in Allah's hands completely
2. **Trust** - We trust Allah to wake us up
3. **Awareness** - We remember death and life are from Allah
4. **Gratitude** - We appreciate waking up (if Allah wills)
5. **Humility** - We're helpless in sleep, totally dependent on Allah

### 🛏️ The Right Way to Sleep:

**Sleep on your right side:**
- This is the sunnah way
- It's also healthy for your heart!
- Doctors say it's good for digestion too

**Right hand under right cheek:**
- Comfortable and natural
- Following the Prophet's way
- Makes you feel secure

### 🌟 Pairing with the Morning Dua:

Remember the dua when you wake up?

**Night:** "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya" (I die and I live)
**Morning:** "Alhamdulillah alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana" (Who gave us life after death)

Perfect pair! You start the night by saying "in Your name I die and live" and you start the morning by thanking Allah for bringing you back to life! 💚

### 💪 What This Dua Reminds Us:

**Every Night:**
- You might not wake up
- Make sure you're ready to meet Allah
- Forgive others before sleeping
- Ask Allah's forgiveness
- Sleep in a state of purity (with wudu if possible)

**Every Morning:**
- If you wake up, say Alhamdulillah!
- You got another chance!
- Make today count!

### 🎯 The Complete Bedtime Routine:

1. **Finish your day:**
   - Pray Isha
   - Say evening adhkar
   - Make sure you're at peace with everyone

2. **Prepare for sleep:**
   - Make wudu (ablution)
   - Shake out your bed (sunnah - removes any insects)
   - Lie on your right side

3. **Say your duas:**
   - "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya"
   - Recite the three Quls
   - Make personal dua

4. **Sleep peacefully!** 😴

### 🌈 Amazing Wisdom:

This short dua makes you think about:
- **Life is temporary** - Every night we "die"
- **Allah controls everything** - He decides who wakes up
- **Be ready** - You might not wake up tomorrow
- **Trust Allah** - Put your affairs in His hands
- **Live well** - Make every day count!

### 💡 For Kids to Understand:

**Before sleep:** You're putting yourself in Allah's care
**During sleep:** Allah watches over you
**If you wake up:** Allah chose to give you another day
**Your response:** Thank Allah and live well! 🌟

### 🎮 Bedtime Checklist:

✅ Prayed Isha?
✅ Made wudu?
✅ Lying on right side?
✅ Right hand under right cheek?
✅ Said "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya"?
✅ Recited the three Quls?
✅ Made your personal dua?
✅ Ready to sleep peacefully! 💤

### 🌟 Beautiful Benefits:

✨ Following the Prophet's exact bedtime sunnah
✨ Putting yourself under Allah's protection
✨ Remembering death makes you live better
✨ Super short and easy to memorize
✨ Last words are remembrance of Allah
✨ Sleep peacefully knowing Allah is watching
✨ Wake up ready to thank Allah
✨ Complete trust in Allah (tawakkul)

### 💙 Remember:

Every night might be your last night. But instead of being scared, this should make you:
- Live better during the day
- Be kind to people
- Do good deeds
- Sleep peacefully knowing you did your best
- Trust Allah with whatever happens

Say "Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya" and sleep in peace! 🌙

> **Parents:** Establish a bedtime routine with your children that includes this dua. Teaching them about the connection between sleep and death in a gentle way helps them appreciate life and develop healthy perspectives on mortality.

**📚 References:**
- *Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, 6314, 6323, 6324*
- *Sahih al-Bukhari 7393*

grow.title: 🥤 The Right Way to Drink Water!
grow.content:
Did you know there's a special way the Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) taught us to drink? Let's learn these beautiful manners!

### The Good Manners of Drinking:

1️⃣ Use Your Right Hand 🖐️
Always hold your cup or glass with your right hand - this is the sunnah way!

2️⃣ Say "Bismillah" 🤲
Before you take your first sip, say "Bismillah" (In the name of Allah). This reminds us that everything good comes from Allah!

3️⃣ Take Three Sips (or More) 💧💧💧
Don't gulp it all down at once! Take small sips and breathe between them. This is healthier and better for your tummy!

4️⃣ Say "Alhamdulillah" 💚
When you finish drinking, say "Alhamdulillah" (All praise is for Allah) to thank Allah for the yummy drink!

5️⃣ Sit Down to Drink 🪑
Try to sit down when you drink. It's better for your body and shows good manners!

6️⃣ If You're Sharing... 🤝
Serving others? You drink LAST - let everyone else drink first! This shows kindness.
Passing drinks to friends? Start with the person on your RIGHT side.

### ❌ Things to Avoid:

🚫 Don't Drink from the Big Bottle or Pitcher
Always pour your drink into a cup or glass first. Don't drink straight from the big container - that's not polite, and you might spill!

🚫 No Gold or Silver Cups
We don't use fancy gold or silver dishes to drink. Simple cups are perfect!

### 🎯 Easy Steps to Remember:

Let's practice! Next time you're thirsty:

BEFORE drinking:

- Sit down (if you can)
- Hold cup with RIGHT hand
- Say "Bismillah"

WHILE drinking: 

- Take small sips - breathe between sips! 
- Don't finish it all in one gulp

AFTER drinking: 

- Say "Alhamdulillah"

### 🌟 Why Follow These Manners?

✨ You're following the Prophet's beautiful example
✨ It's healthier for your body (doctors say drinking slowly is better!)
✨ You're remembering Allah throughout the day
✨ You're showing good manners to everyone around you
✨ You earn rewards from Allah for doing things His way!

### 🎮 Fun Challenge!

Try to follow ALL these steps every time you drink today! 

Can you do it? Ask your family to join you and see who remembers all the steps!

You can even make a little checklist:
- Right hand?
- Said Bismillah?
- Sitting down?
- Three sips?
- Said Alhamdulillah?

### 💙 Remember:

Even something as simple as drinking water can be an act of worship when we do it the way the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) taught us! Every sip can earn you good deeds! 🌟
---
> Parents: Practicing these etiquettes helps children develop mindfulness, gratitude, and good habits that combine both spiritual and physical benefits!

grow.title: 💬 Speak Good Words or Stay Quiet!
grow.content:
## 🗣️ What the Prophet Taught Us:

The Prophet Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) said:

> "If you believe in Allah and the Last Day, then speak good or stay silent!" [Muslim]

This means: If you're going to say something, make sure it's something GOOD and KIND! If you can't say something good, then it's better to stay quiet. 😊

### 🤔 Why Is This Important?

Sometimes we might find ourselves:

❌ Talking about things that don't really matter
❌ Wasting our time chatting about stuff that doesn't help us learn or grow
❌ Saying mean things about other people or situations (this is called gossip, and it's not nice!)

### 💭 Think Before You Speak!

Before you say something, ask yourself:

- Is this kind?
- Is this helpful?
- Is this true?
- Would I want someone to say this about me?

If the answer is NO, then it's better to keep quiet!

### ✨ The Amazing Benefits!

When you follow this sunnah, wonderful things happen:

⏰ You save time! - No more wasting hours on useless talk
🧠 You have more energy! - Your brain isn't tired from thinking about silly things
😇 You become a better person! - People will love being around you
🎯 You can do better things like:
- Reading Quran 📖
- Helping your family 🏠
- Doing your homework 📚
- Playing nicely with friends 🤝
- Learning something new 🌱
- Making dua to Allah 🤲

### 🎯 Quick Tips for Kids:

1️⃣ Before speaking, think: "Is this good to say?"
2️⃣ If you're angry or upset, take a deep breath and stay quiet until you feel calm
3️⃣ Say nice things like "JazakAllah Khair," "Thank you," "Good job!"
4️⃣ If someone is gossiping, don't join in - change the topic or walk away
5️⃣ Use your words to help others - give compliments, share knowledge, make people smile!

### 💚 Remember:
Your words are powerful! Use them to spread goodness and happiness. When in doubt, remember the Prophet's advice: Speak good or stay quiet!

This simple rule can make you a kinder person and bring you closer to Allah! 🌟

Parents: This sunnah teaches children mindfulness, kindness, and the value of meaningful communication - skills that will benefit them throughout their lives!

grow.title: Keep Your Mouth Clean
grow.content:
## Did You Know? 🪥

Being clean is a **SUPER** important part of being a good Muslim!

Prophet Muhammad ﷺ used a special stick called **Siwak** to clean his teeth many times every day!

### 💚 What the Prophet Said:

Aaishah (ra) told us that the Prophet ﷺ said:

> "Siwak cleans the mouth and makes Allah happy!"

Abu Huraira (ra) told us that the Prophet ﷺ said:

> "If it wasn't too hard for my ummah (people), I would tell them to use Siwak before every prayer!"

### ⏰ When Should You Use Siwak?

Here are the best times to use your Siwak:

- 🌙 **When you wake up** — Start your day with a clean mouth!
- 📖 **Before reading Quran** — Clean your mouth for Allah's words
- 🤲 **Before making wudhu and praying** — Get ready for salah
- 🏠 **When you come home** — Greet your family with a fresh smile
- 🕌 **Before going to the masjid** — Be clean for Allah's house
- 😮 **When your breath doesn't smell fresh** — Keep it nice and clean!

### ⚠️ Important! What NOT to Use:

- ❌ Sticks that are poisonous or dangerous
- ❌ Dirty things (always keep it clean!)
- ❌ Sharp things that can hurt your gums or make you bleed
- ❌ Soft things like cloth or your fingers (they don't work like Siwak!)

### 🎯 Remember:

Keeping your mouth clean is a way to show love for Allah and follow the Prophet's example. It's easy, healthy, and makes Allah smile at you! 😊

*Parents: Using Siwak or a toothbrush regularly teaches children about cleanliness in Islam and helps build healthy habits!*

grow.title: ❤️ Love the Prophet ﷺ More Than Anyone!
grow.content:
Did you know? You can't have complete faith until you love Prophet Muhammad ﷺ more than your parents and everyone else! Let's learn why! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ

**Translation:**

"None of you will have faith until I am more beloved to him than his father, his children, and all mankind."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 2 (Belief), Hadith 15; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 44

**Narrated by:** Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💎 You'll Be With Who You Love!

A man asked the Prophet ﷺ: **"When will the Hour (Day of Judgment) be?"**

The Prophet ﷺ asked: **"What have you prepared for it?"**

The man said: **"Nothing, except that I love Allah and His Messenger!"**

The Prophet ﷺ said: **"You will be with those whom you love!"**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 3688

**Narrated by:** Anas (may Allah be pleased with him)

SubhanAllah! If you love the Prophet ﷺ, you'll be WITH him in Jannah! 🌟

## 🌟 How to Show Your Love:

**1. Follow His Example! 👣**
- Pray like he prayed
- Be kind like he was kind
- Eat like he ate
- Sleep like he slept

**2. Send Blessings on Him! 💚**

Say daily:

**Arabic:**

اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ

**Transliteration:**

Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammad wa 'ala ali Muhammad

**3. Learn About His Life! 📚**
- Read stories about him
- Learn his Sunnah
- Know his character

**4. Defend His Honor! 🛡️**
- Never allow anyone to insult him
- Speak respectfully about him always

## 💚 Remember:

Loving the Prophet ﷺ = Being with him in Jannah! 🌟

*Parents: Teach children to love the Prophet ﷺ through stories, examples, and following his Sunnah daily!*

grow.title: 🤧 Say Alhamdulillah When You Sneeze!
grow.content:
Did you know? Even sneezing has special manners in Islam! Let's learn what to say! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ فَلْيَقُلْ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ

**Translation:**

"If anyone of you sneezes, he should say 'Alhamdulillah' (Praise be to Allah), and his brother or companion should say to him, 'Yarhamukallah' (May Allah bestow His Mercy on you). When the latter says 'Yarhamukallah', the former should say, 'Yahdikumullah wa Yuslihu balakum' (May Allah give you guidance and improve your condition)."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 78 (Good Manners), Hadith 6224

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 🌟 The Complete Conversation:

**Person 1 sneezes:** 🤧

Says: **"Alhamdulillah!"**

**Person 2 hears it:**

Says: **"Yarhamukallah!"** (May Allah have mercy on you)

**Person 1 replies:**

Says: **"Yahdikumullah wa Yuslihu balakum!"** (May Allah guide you and improve your condition)

## 💎 Cover Your Mouth!

The Prophet ﷺ used to cover his face with his hand or garment when sneezing!

**Reference:** Jami' At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 2745 (Hasan Sahih)

So always cover your mouth and nose when you sneeze! 🤲

## 🎯 Quick Guide:

**When YOU sneeze:**
1. Cover your mouth ✅
2. Say "Alhamdulillah" ✅
3. Wait for reply ✅
4. Say "Yahdikumullah wa Yuslihu balakum" ✅

**When SOMEONE ELSE sneezes:**
1. Listen if they say "Alhamdulillah" ✅
2. Reply with "Yarhamukallah" ✅

## 💚 Remember:

Allah LOVES sneezing because it removes illness from your body!

So every time you sneeze, thank Allah! 🌟

*Parents: Practice this with children at home. Make it a fun habit that teaches manners and gratitude!*

grow.title: 🤲 Always Return to Allah - He Loves Repentance!
grow.content:
Did you know? Allah LOVES when you come back to Him after making mistakes! Let's learn about repentance! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً

**Translation:**

"By Allah! I ask Allah for forgiveness and repent to Him more than seventy times a day."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 80 (Asking for Forgiveness), Hadith 6307

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Even the Prophet ﷺ - who was SINLESS - asked forgiveness 70+ times daily! 🌟

## 💎 Allah is HAPPIER Than You Can Imagine!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Allah is more pleased with the repentance of His servant than a person who lost his camel in the desert, then found it!"**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6309; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2747

Imagine losing your most precious thing, then finding it! Allah is HAPPIER than that when you repent! SubhanAllah! 💚

## 🌟 The Amazing Story!

A man killed 99 people! Then he wanted to repent. He asked a scholar: **"Can Allah forgive me?"**

The scholar said: **"YES! Who can stand between you and repentance? Go to this village and worship Allah there."**

The man started going, but died on the way. The Angels of Mercy and Angels of Punishment argued about him.

Allah told them: **"Measure which village he was closer to."**

He was closer to the good village by ONE HAND-SPAN! So the Angels of Mercy took him!

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 3470; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2766

He killed 99 people but was forgiven! That's Allah's mercy! 🌈

## 🎯 How to Repent:

**1. Stop the Sin!** 🛑
Immediately stop doing the wrong thing!

**2. Feel Sorry! 😢**
Regret what you did in your heart!

**3. Ask Allah for Forgiveness! 🤲**
Say: "Astaghfirullah" (I seek Allah's forgiveness)

**4. Promise NOT to Do It Again! 💪**
Mean it! Try your best!

**5. If You Hurt Someone, Apologize! 🙏**
Make it right with them!

## 💚 The Best Dua for Forgiveness:

**Arabic:**

اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ

**Translation:**

"O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I am faithful to my covenant as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil I have committed. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You."

This is called "Sayyid Al-Istighfar" (The Master of Seeking Forgiveness)!

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6306

## 💎 Remember:

- Allah forgives ALL sins if you truly repent! ✨
- Don't give up on Allah's mercy! 💚
- Repent immediately - don't delay! ⚡
- Even if you repeat the sin, repent again! 🔄

Let's make repentance our daily habit! Say "Astaghfirullah" 100 times today! 🌟

*Parents: Teach children that mistakes are opportunities to grow closer to Allah through repentance. This builds hope and prevents despair!*

grow.title: 👅 Guard Your Tongue - The Key to Paradise!
grow.content:
Did you know? If you control your tongue and private parts, the Prophet ﷺ guarantees you PARADISE! Let's learn why! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ

**Translation:**

"Whoever can guarantee (the chastity of) what is between his two jaw-bones (tongue) and what is between his two legs (private parts), I guarantee Paradise for him."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 81 (Ar-Riqaq), Hadith 6474

**Narrated by:** Sahl ibn Sa'd (may Allah be pleased with him)

Wow! Control these two things = GUARANTEED Jannah! 🌟

## 💎 What is a TRUE Muslim?

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand the Muslims are safe."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 2 (Belief), Hadith 10

**Narrated by:** Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with him)

So a TRUE Muslim doesn't hurt people with words OR actions! 💚

## 🌟 Your Tongue is POWERFUL!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"A person may speak a word without thinking about its consequences, but because of it, he will plunge into the Hellfire farther than the distance between the east and west."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

One bad word can destroy you! Be VERY careful! ⚠️

## 💚 What to Avoid:

❌ **Lying** - Even "small" lies!
❌ **Backbiting** - Talking bad about people
❌ **Gossiping** - Spreading secrets
❌ **Cursing** - Using bad words
❌ **Insulting** - Making fun of others
❌ **Arguing** - Fighting with words
❌ **Complaining** - Always being negative

## 🎯 What to Say Instead:

✅ **Truth** - Always be honest
✅ **Good things** - Praise and encourage
✅ **Dhikr** - Remember Allah
✅ **Dua** - Make supplication
✅ **Quran** - Recite Allah's words
✅ **Knowledge** - Teach and learn
✅ **Kind words** - Spread love!

## 💎 The Golden Rule:

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

If you can't say something GOOD - stay QUIET! 🤐

## 🌟 The Tongue Challenge:

**This Week:**

☑️ Think before speaking
☑️ Don't gossip or backbite
☑️ Say "Alhamdulillah" 100 times daily
☑️ Only speak truth
☑️ Don't argue or insult
☑️ Use kind words ONLY!

Guard your tongue = Guarantee Jannah! 💚✨

*Parents: Teach children that words have power and consequences. Model good speech. This hadith from Bukhari shows tongue control is essential for Paradise!*

grow.title: 🕌 Pray in Congregation - 27 Times More Reward!
grow.content:
Did you know? Praying with other Muslims gives you 27 times MORE reward than praying alone! Let's learn why! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَةِ تَفْضُلُ صَلاَةَ الْفَذِّ بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً

**Translation:**

"Prayer in congregation is twenty-seven times superior to prayer offered by a person alone."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 11 (Call to Prayers), Hadith 645 (also numbered as 618, 619); Sahih Muslim, Hadith 650

**Narrated by:** Abdullah ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with him)

Wow! 27 times more reward! That's AMAZING! ✨

## 💎 Every Step = Rewards!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"When one performs ablution and does it perfectly, and then proceeds to the mosque with the sole intention of praying, then for each step which he takes towards the mosque, Allah upgrades him a degree in reward and crosses out one sin."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 477 (Book 8, Prayers)

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Every step to the masjid = 1 good deed + 1 sin erased! 🚶✨

## 🌟 Angels Pray for You!

**"When he enters the mosque, he is considered in prayer as long as he is waiting for the prayer. The angels keep on asking for Allah's forgiveness for him and they keep on saying: 'O Allah! Be Merciful to him, O Allah! Forgive him!'"**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 477; Sahih Muslim

Angels are making dua for YOU while you wait! How beautiful! 😇

## 💚 Special Rewards:

**1. Isha and Fajr in Jamaat = Like Praying All Night!**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever prays Isha in congregation, it is as if he stood half of the night. And whoever prays Fajr in congregation, it is as if he stood the entire night (in prayer)."**

**Reference:** Jami' At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 221 (Sahih)

**Narrated by:** Uthman ibn Affan (may Allah be pleased with him)

Just Isha + Fajr in jamaat = WHOLE night prayer reward! SubhanAllah! 🌙

## 🎯 Benefits of Praying in Jamaat:

✅ **27 times more reward!**
✅ **Every step = good deeds!**
✅ **Angels pray for you!**
✅ **Sins are erased!**
✅ **Meet other Muslims!**
✅ **Learn from Imam!**
✅ **Feel the unity of Ummah!**

## 💎 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ said he wanted to burn the houses of those who didn't come to congregation! That's how important it is!

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

So try your best to pray in the masjid with your family! 🕌💚

*Parents: Take children to the masjid for congregational prayers. This builds community bonds and love for the masjid. Boys especially should attend!*

grow.title: 🌸 Be Gentle - Allah LOVES Gentleness!
grow.content:
Did you know? Allah loves when you're gentle and gives you rewards He doesn't give for anything else! Let's learn about gentleness! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ

**Translation:**

"Verily, Allah is gentle and He loves gentleness in all matters."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6927; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2593

**Narrated by:** Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her)

Allah loves gentleness in EVERYTHING! 🌟

## 💎 Gentleness Gets Special Rewards!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Allah is gentle and He loves gentleness. He grants reward for gentleness what is not given for harshness or anything else."**

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2593

**Narrated by:** Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her)

Gentleness = SPECIAL rewards you can't get any other way! ✨

## 🌟 Gentleness Makes Everything Beautiful!

The Prophet ﷺ said to Aisha:

**"You must be gentle. Whenever gentleness is in something, it beautifies it. When it is removed from something, it makes it ugly."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6030; Sahih Muslim

Gentleness makes everything BEAUTIFUL! 🌸

## 💚 What is Gentleness?

Being gentle means:
- Speaking softly ✅
- Being patient ✅
- Not getting angry quickly ✅
- Treating people kindly ✅
- Not being rough or harsh ✅
- Being merciful ✅

## 🎯 Real-Life Examples:

**At Home:** 🏠
- Speak gently to your parents
- Play gently with siblings
- Handle things with care
- Don't slam doors!

**At School:** 📚
- Be gentle with friends
- Don't push or shove
- Speak kindly to teachers
- Handle books carefully

**With Animals:** 🐱
- Pet them softly
- Don't hit or hurt them
- Give them food gently
- Be kind and caring!

## 💎 The Gentle Challenge:

**This Week:**

☑️ Speak gently to everyone
☑️ Handle things carefully
☑️ Be patient when upset
☑️ Treat animals kindly
☑️ Don't be rough or harsh!

Be gentle in EVERYTHING! Allah is watching! 💚✨

*Parents: Model gentleness in speech and actions. Children learn by observing. These hadiths from Bukhari and Muslim emphasize that gentleness is beloved to Allah!*

grow.title: 🚪 Always Ask Permission Before Entering!
grow.content:
Did you know? You should NEVER enter someone's room without knocking and asking permission first! Let's learn this important manner! 🚪

## 📖 What Happened:

Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated:

**"I came to the Prophet ﷺ in order to consult him regarding my father's debt. When I knocked on the door, he asked, 'Who is that?' I replied, 'I.' He said, 'I, I?' He repeated it as if he disliked it."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 79 (Asking Permission), Hadith 6250

**Narrated by:** Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him)

The Prophet ﷺ didn't like when people just said "I" without saying their name! 🌟

## 💎 The Right Way:

When you knock, you should:

1. Knock THREE times (not more!) 🚪🚪🚪
2. Say your NAME clearly
3. Wait for permission
4. If no answer after 3 knocks, LEAVE!

## 🌟 Why is This Important?

Allah says in the Quran:

**"O you who believe! Do not enter houses other than your own until you have asked permission and greeted their inhabitants."** (Quran 24:27)

This protects people's privacy! 💚

## 🎯 Real-Life Examples:

**At Home:** 🏠
- Knock on your parents' bedroom door
- Knock on siblings' rooms
- Don't just barge in!

**Visiting Friends:** 👫
- Knock on the front door
- Say your name clearly
- Wait to be invited in

**At School:** 📚
- Knock on the teacher's office
- Wait for "Come in!"
- Don't just walk in!

## 💚 Remember:

✅ Always knock three times
✅ Say your name clearly
✅ Wait for permission
✅ Respect people's privacy!

This is good manners AND following the Sunnah! 🌟

*Parents: Teach children to respect privacy by always knocking. Model this behavior yourself. These manners build respect and consideration for others!*

grow.title: ⏰ Don't Stay Angry for More Than 3 Days!
grow.content:
Did you know? You're NOT allowed to stay angry at another Muslim for more than 3 days! Let's learn why! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

لاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلاَمِ

**Translation:**

"It is not lawful for a Muslim to desert (not to speak to) his brother Muslim for more than three days while meeting, one turns his face to one side and the other turns his face to the other side. The better of the two is the one who starts greeting the other first."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 79 (Asking Permission), Hadith 6237; Also in Sahih Muslim

**Narrated by:** Abu Aiyub (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💎 Why Only 3 Days?

The Prophet ﷺ knew that:
- Sometimes we get upset 😔
- We need time to cool down 🧊
- But we can't stay angry forever! ⏰

3 days is ENOUGH time to calm down and make up! 💚

## 🌟 Who is Better?

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**The BETTER person is the one who says Salam FIRST!**

Don't wait for the other person! BE THE BETTER ONE! 🌟

## 🎯 What to Do:

**Day 1:** You get into a fight 😤
**Day 2:** Still upset, but cooling down 🧊
**Day 3:** Think: "I need to fix this!" 💭
**Day 4 (MAX!):** Go say Salam and make up! 🤝

## 💚 How to Make Up:

1. Say "As-Salamu Alaikum" first 👋
2. Apologize if you were wrong 🙏
3. Forgive if they were wrong 💚
4. Shake hands or hug 🤝
5. Be friends again! 😊

## 💎 Remember:

Life is too short to stay angry!

The better person is the one who makes peace FIRST!

Don't let Shaytan keep you apart! 🌟

*Parents: Teach children to resolve conflicts quickly. Model making peace with family members. This hadith from Bukhari and Muslim emphasizes maintaining Muslim brotherhood!*

grow.title: 💚 Love People for Allah's Sake!
grow.content:
Did you know? If you love someone for Allah's sake, you'll be under Allah's shade on the Day of Judgment! Let's learn about this amazing reward! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

سَبْعَةٌ يُظِلُّهُمُ اللَّهُ فِي ظِلِّهِ يَوْمَ لاَ ظِلَّ إِلاَّ ظِلُّهُ... وَرَجُلاَنِ تَحَابَّا فِي اللَّهِ اجْتَمَعَا عَلَيْهِ وَتَفَرَّقَا عَلَيْهِ

**Translation:**

"Seven people will be shaded by Allah under His shade on the Day when there will be no shade except His... Two people who love each other for Allah's sake, meeting for that purpose and parting upon that."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 660; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 1031

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Loving for Allah's sake = Special shade on Judgment Day! ✨

## 💎 What Does it Mean?

Loving someone for Allah's sake means:
- You love them because they're good Muslims ✅
- You love them because they help you be better ✅
- You love them to please Allah, not for money or favors ✅
- You meet to do good things together ✅

## 🌟 Examples:

**Good Friends for Allah:** 💚
- You both pray together
- You help each other with Quran
- You remind each other of Allah
- You do good deeds together

**NOT for Allah:** ❌
- You're friends only because they're rich
- You're friends only because they're popular
- You're friends only for fun and games
- You don't care about their faith

## 🎯 How to Have Friends for Allah:

1. Choose friends who pray ✅
2. Do good things together ✅
3. Remind each other of Allah ✅
4. Help each other be better Muslims ✅
5. Make dua for each other ✅

## 💚 Remember:

The best friendships are those that bring you closer to Allah!

Choose friends who will be with you in Jannah! 🌟

*Parents: Encourage children to befriend practicing Muslim children. These friendships can last forever - in this life and the next!*

grow.title: 🤐 Say Good or Stay Silent!
grow.content:
Did you know? If you can't say something good, you should just be QUIET! Let's learn this simple but powerful rule! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ

**Translation:**

"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6018; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 47

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Only TWO choices: Good words OR silence! 🤐

## 💎 The Golden Rule:

**Before you speak, ask yourself:**

1. Is it TRUE? 🤔
2. Is it KIND? 💚
3. Is it NECESSARY? 📝

If you can't say YES to all three:

**STAY QUIET!** 🤐

## 🌟 What is "Good Speech"?

✅ Words that help someone
✅ Words that teach something
✅ Words that make peace
✅ Words that spread happiness
✅ Words that remember Allah
✅ Words that are truthful and kind

## ⚠️ What is "Bad Speech"?

❌ Lies
❌ Gossip
❌ Mean words
❌ Insults
❌ Backbiting
❌ Unnecessary chatter
❌ Arguments

## 🎯 Real-Life Examples:

**Situation 1:**
You see someone wearing something ugly.
- BAD: "That looks terrible!"
- GOOD: Stay silent! OR "You look nice!"

**Situation 2:**
You want to gossip about a classmate.
- BAD: "Did you hear what she did?"
- GOOD: Stay silent! Change the topic!

**Situation 3:**
Someone asks your opinion.
- BAD: "That's the worst idea ever!"
- GOOD: "Maybe we could try this instead..."

## 💚 Benefits of Silence:

- You don't hurt people's feelings 💚
- You don't spread gossip 🚫
- You don't get into trouble 😊
- You don't say things you'll regret 🙏
- You have time to think 🤔

## 💎 The Speaking Challenge:

**This Week:**

Before EVERY word you say, think:
- "Is this good?"
- If YES → Say it! 😊
- If NO → Stay quiet! 🤐

Count how many times you stopped yourself from saying something bad!

Each time = saved yourself from sin! 🌟

## 🌈 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ said if you believe in Allah and the Last Day:

**Speak GOOD or be SILENT!**

There's NO third option!

Let's be people of good speech! 💚✨

*Parents: This hadith from Bukhari and Muslim is a life-changing principle. Help children practice the "think before you speak" habit. Model it yourself!*

grow.title: 🌟 The Best Muslims Have the Best Manners!
grow.content:
Did you know? The Prophet ﷺ said the best believers are those with the BEST character! Let's learn why manners are so important! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلاَقًا

**Translation:**

"The most beloved of you to me and the nearest of you to me in seating on the Day of Resurrection will be those of you with the best character."

**Reference:** Jami' At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 2018 (authenticated as Hasan)

**Narrated by:** Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him)

Best manners = Sitting CLOSE to the Prophet ﷺ in Jannah! 🌟

## 💎 The Heaviest Thing!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Nothing will be heavier on the Day of Resurrection in the scale of the believer than good character."**

**Reference:** Jami' At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 2003 (Sahih)

**Narrated by:** Abu Darda (may Allah be pleased with him)

Good character is the HEAVIEST good deed! 💪

## 🌟 What Are Good Manners?

✅ Being honest
✅ Being kind
✅ Being patient
✅ Being forgiving
✅ Being respectful
✅ Being helpful
✅ Being gentle
✅ Being grateful
✅ Being humble
✅ Being cheerful!

## 🎯 How to Have Good Manners:

**At Home:** 🏠
- Respect your parents
- Be kind to siblings
- Help with chores
- Speak politely

**At School:** 📚
- Be nice to classmates
- Listen to teachers
- Share with friends
- Don't bully anyone

**Everywhere:** 🌍
- Smile at people
- Say please and thank you
- Help those in need
- Be a good person!

## 💚 The Manners Checklist:

**This Week, Practice:**

☑️ Smile at 10 people daily
☑️ Say "please" and "thank you"
☑️ Help someone without being asked
☑️ Be patient when upset
☑️ Forgive someone who hurt you
☑️ Be gentle in speech
☑️ Show respect to elders

## 💎 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"I was sent to perfect good character."**

**Reference:** Al-Muwatta, authenticated as Sahih

Good manners = Core of Islam!

Let's have the BEST character and sit close to the Prophet ﷺ in Jannah! 🌟💚

*Parents: Character development is the foundation of Islamic upbringing. These hadiths show that good manners are more important than just ritual worship. Model excellent character daily!*

grow.title: 🌟 Friday - The Best Day of the Week!
grow.content:
Did you know? Friday is the BEST day of the whole week! Let's learn what makes it so special! ✨

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

خَيْرُ يَوْمٍ طَلَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ يَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ أُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ وَفِيهِ أُخْرِجَ مِنْهَا

**Translation:**

"The best day on which the sun has risen is Friday. On it Adam was created, on it he was admitted to Paradise, and on it he was expelled from it."

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Hadith 854

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💎 Take a Bath on Friday!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Taking a bath on Friday is compulsory for every Muslim who has reached puberty."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 13 (Friday Prayer), Hadith 858; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 846

**Narrated by:** Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him)

Be clean and smell nice for Friday prayer! 🛁

## 🕌 Go Early to Friday Prayer!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever takes a bath on Friday like the bath of Janaba, then goes in the first hour, it is as if he sacrificed a camel. Whoever goes in the second hour, it is as if he sacrificed a cow. Whoever goes in the third hour, it is as if he sacrificed a ram. Whoever goes in the fourth hour, it is as if he sacrificed a hen. Whoever goes in the fifth hour, it is as if he sacrificed an egg."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 881

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Go EARLY for MORE rewards! 🐪🐄🐏🐔🥚

## 🤲 Make LOTS of Dua!

There's a special time on Friday when ALL duas are answered!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"On Friday there is an hour when no Muslim asks Allah for anything except that He will give it to him."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

So make dua on Friday - especially in the afternoon! 🌟

## 💚 Friday Checklist:

✅ Take a bath/shower
✅ Wear clean clothes
✅ Use perfume
✅ Go to Masjid early
✅ Listen to Khutbah quietly
✅ Make LOTS of dua!
✅ Send blessings on Prophet ﷺ

## 🌟 Remember:

Friday is a gift from Allah! Make it special by:
- Being extra clean 🛁
- Going to the masjid 🕌
- Making dua 🤲
- Being kind to everyone! 💚

*Parents: Make Friday special! Help children prepare early and attend Jummah prayer. This builds love for this blessed day!*

grow.title: ⚖️ Stand Up for What's Right!
grow.content:
Did you know? When you see something wrong, you should try to stop it! Let's learn how! 💪

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

مَنْ رَأَى مِنْكُمْ مُنْكَرًا فَلْيُغَيِّرْهُ بِيَدِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِلِسَانِهِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَبِقَلْبِهِ وَذَلِكَ أَضْعَفُ الإِيمَانِ

**Translation:**

"Whoever sees an evil should change it with his hand. If he is unable, then with his tongue. If he is still unable, then with his heart, and that is the weakest level of faith."

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Hadith 49

**Narrated by:** Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💡 Three Ways to Stop Wrong:

**1. With Your Hand ✋**

If you CAN physically stop it:
- Remove trash from the road
- Turn off wasted water
- Stop a fight between friends

**2. With Your Tongue 🗣️**

If you can't physically stop it, SPEAK UP:
- "That's wrong, please don't do it!"
- "This is haram, we shouldn't do this!"
- Tell an adult who can help

**3. With Your Heart 💚**

If you can't do anything:
- Hate it in your heart
- Don't participate
- Make dua for it to stop

## 🎯 Real Examples:

**At School:**
- Friend about to cheat? Tell them it's wrong!
- Someone bullying? Tell a teacher!
- Can't stop it? Don't join in!

**At Home:**
- Sibling wasting food? Remind them!
- TV showing bad things? Change the channel!
- Can't change it? Leave the room!

## 💚 Remember:

**Always:**
✅ Be respectful when correcting
✅ Speak kindly
✅ Ask adults for help
✅ Never use violence!

Standing up for what's right = being brave for Allah! 🌟

*Parents: Teach children to recognize right from wrong and speak up appropriately. This builds moral courage within safe boundaries!*

grow.title: 🐪 Trust Allah BUT Tie Your Camel!
grow.content:
Did you know? Trusting Allah doesn't mean you don't work hard! Let's learn this important lesson! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

أَعْقِلْهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ

**Translation:**

A man asked: "O Messenger of Allah, should I tie my camel and trust in Allah, or leave it untied and trust in Allah?"

The Prophet ﷺ replied: **"Tie it and trust in Allah."**

**Reference:** Jami' At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 2517 (authenticated as Hasan by Al-Albani)

**Narrated by:** Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💎 What Does This Mean?

It means:
- **DO your part** (tie the camel) 🐪
- **THEN trust Allah** for the result 🤲

You can't just sit and wait for things to happen! You must TRY, then trust Allah! 🌟

## 🎯 Real-Life Examples:

**At School:** 📚
- Study hard for your test 📖
- THEN make dua for success 🤲
- Don't just make dua without studying!

**Want Good Health:** 🏃
- Eat healthy food 🥗
- Exercise regularly 💪
- THEN trust Allah to keep you healthy!

**Want Money:** 💰
- Work hard 🔨
- Save wisely 💵
- THEN trust Allah for provision!

**Want Friends:** 👫
- Be kind to people 💚
- Be a good friend yourself 🤝
- THEN trust Allah to bless you with friends!

## 🌟 Remember:

**Allah helps those who help themselves!**

Don't be lazy and say "I trust Allah" - that's not real trust (Tawakkul)!

Real trust = Do YOUR best + Trust Allah for the REST! 💚✨

*Parents: This hadith teaches responsibility and balanced faith. Children learn that effort and trust in Allah go hand in hand!*

grow.title: 👫 Choose Good Friends - They're Like Perfume!
grow.content:
Did you know? Your friends are like perfume or smoke - they affect you! Let's learn how to choose wisely! 🌸

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

مَثَلُ الْجَلِيسِ الصَّالِحِ وَالْجَلِيسِ السَّوْءِ كَمَثَلِ صَاحِبِ الْمِسْكِ وَكِيرِ الْحَدَّادِ

**Translation:**

"The example of a good companion and a bad companion is like that of a musk seller and a blacksmith. The musk seller might give you some perfume, or you might buy from him, or at least you'll smell its good fragrance. As for the blacksmith, he will either burn your body or your clothes, or you'll get a bad smell from him."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 34 (Sales and Trade), Hadith 2101; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2628

**Narrated by:** Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💚 Good Friend = Perfume! 🌸

A good friend:
- Makes you smell nice (do good deeds!) ✨
- Gives you gifts (good advice!) 🎁
- Makes you happy! 😊
- Reminds you of Allah! 💚
- Helps you be better! 🌟

## ⚠️ Bad Friend = Smoke! 💨

A bad friend:
- Burns you (leads you to sin!) 🔥
- Makes you smell bad (bad behavior!) 😢
- Hurts you! 😤
- Makes you forget Allah! 😭
- Makes you worse! 📉

## 🎯 How to Choose Friends:

**Good Friends:**
✅ Pray regularly
✅ Are honest and kind
✅ Help you do good
✅ Make you think of Allah
✅ Are respectful to parents

**Bad Friends:**
❌ Skip prayers
❌ Lie and cheat
❌ Lead you to trouble
❌ Make you forget Allah
❌ Disrespect parents

## 🌟 The Friend Test:

Ask yourself:
- Does this friend make me better or worse?
- Do they remind me of Allah or make me forget Him?
- Would the Prophet ﷺ approve of this friendship?

If the answer is NO - find better friends! 💚

## 💎 Remember:

**You become like your friends!**

Choose friends who will lead you to JANNAH, not to JAHANNAM! 🌟

*Parents: Monitor friendships and guide children toward righteous companions. This hadith from Bukhari and Muslim shows how crucial good company is!*

grow.title: 😤 Control Your Anger - That's TRUE Strength!
grow.content:
Did you know? The STRONGEST person is NOT the one who can fight - it's the one who controls their anger! Let's learn this important lesson! 💪

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ

**Translation:**

"The strong person is not the one who can wrestle (overpower others). Rather, the strong person is the one who controls himself when angry."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 78 (Good Manners), Hadith 6114; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2609

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Wow! Real strength = controlling your anger! 🌟

## 💎 The Prophet's Best Advice:

A man came to the Prophet ﷺ and asked: **"Give me advice!"**

The Prophet ﷺ said: **"Do not get angry."**

The man asked AGAIN and AGAIN, and each time the Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Do not get angry."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6116

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

That's how important it is! The Prophet ﷺ repeated it many times! 💚

## 🌟 What Happens When You're Angry?

Sulayman ibn Sard said:

"I was sitting with the Prophet ﷺ when two men were arguing. One of them became SO angry that his face turned RED and the veins on his neck were bulging!"

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"I know a word which, if he says it, his anger will go away. If he says 'A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan' (I seek refuge with Allah from Satan), his anger will leave him."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 59 (Beginning of Creation), Hadith 3282

**Narrated by:** Sulayman ibn Sard (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💚 How to Control Your Anger:

**1. Seek Refuge from Shaytan! 🛡️**

Say immediately:

**Arabic:**

أَعُوذُ بِاللهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ

**Transliteration:**

A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan ar-rajim

**Meaning:**

I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed.

Anger comes from Shaytan! Drive him away! 👹❌

**2. Change Your Position! 🔄**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"When one of you becomes angry while standing, he should sit down. If the anger leaves him, well and good; otherwise he should lie down."**

**Reference:** Sunan Abu Dawud, Hadith 4782 (authenticated as Sahih)

**Narrated by:** Abu Dharr (may Allah be pleased with him)

Standing → Sit down 🪑
Still angry? → Lie down 🛏️

**3. Make Wudu! 💧**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Anger comes from Satan, and Satan was created from fire. Fire is extinguished with water, so when you get angry, make wudu."**

**Reference:** Sunan Abu Dawud, Hadith 4784

**Narrated by:** Atiyyah as-Sa'di (may Allah be pleased with him)

Cool down with water! 💦

**4. Stay Silent! 🤐**

Don't say anything when you're angry! You might say something you'll regret!

**5. Remember Allah's Reward! 🎁**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever controls his anger when he has the power to act upon it, Allah will fill his heart with satisfaction on the Day of Resurrection."**

**Reference:** Sunan At-Tirmidhi (authenticated as Hasan)

## 🎯 Quick Anger-Control Steps:

**When you feel angry:**

1. Say "A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan" 🗣️
2. If standing, sit down 🪑
3. If still angry, lie down 🛏️
4. Make wudu if possible 💧
5. Stay silent - don't speak! 🤐
6. Take deep breaths 😮‍💨
7. Leave the situation if you can 🚶

## 💎 Why Should We Control Anger?

**1. Anger is from Shaytan! 👹**

Don't let Shaytan control you!

**2. It Ruins Relationships! 💔**

You might hurt people you love!

**3. You'll Regret It Later! 😢**

What you say in anger can't be taken back!

**4. Allah Loves Those Who Control It! 💚**

Allah says in the Quran:

**"Those who control their anger and pardon others - Allah loves those who do good."** (Quran 3:134)

## 🌈 Real-Life Examples:

**At School:** 📚
- Friend takes your pencil? Don't yell! Ask nicely.
- Someone pushes you? Don't fight! Walk away.
- Lost a game? Don't get angry! Say "Good game!"

**At Home:** 🏠
- Sibling breaks your toy? Don't scream! Breathe and forgive.
- Parents say "No"? Don't argue! Accept it calmly.
- Someone uses your stuff? Don't shout! Talk politely.

**Anywhere:** 🌍
- Someone says something mean? Don't react! Stay calm.
- Things don't go your way? Don't get upset! Make dua.
- Feeling frustrated? Don't explode! Control yourself!

## 🌟 The Anger-Control Challenge:

**This Week:**

☑️ When you feel angry, say "A'udhu billahi min ash-shaytan"
☑️ Practice sitting/lying down when upset
☑️ Make wudu when feeling angry
☑️ Count to 10 before speaking
☑️ Walk away from situations that anger you
☑️ Apologize if you DO get angry
☑️ Make dua for self-control!

## 💚 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ was the BEST at controlling anger. People would insult him, hurt him, but he NEVER lost control! He was patient and forgiving!

Let's be like him! When you feel angry:
- Think: "The Prophet ﷺ stayed calm!"
- Remember: "Real strength = self-control!"
- Say: "I will control myself for Allah!"

Don't be a WRESTLER - be a CONTROLLER! 💪✨

*Parents: Teach children that anger is natural but must be managed. Model anger control yourself. These authentic hadiths from Bukhari, Muslim, and Abu Dawud provide practical steps!*

grow.title: 🌱 Be Humble - Allah Loves the Humble!
grow.content:
Did you know? When you become humble for Allah's sake, Allah raises your status! Let's learn this beautiful quality! 💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ

**Translation:**

"No one humbles himself for Allah's sake except that Allah raises him (in status)."**

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2588; Also in Sahih al-Bukhari

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

SubhanAllah! Being humble makes you HIGHER, not lower! 🌟

## 💎 Allah Commands Humility!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**Arabic:**

إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَوْحَى إِلَيَّ أَنْ تَوَاضَعُوا حَتَّى لاَ يَبْغِيَ أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ وَلاَ يَفْخَرَ أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ

**Translation:**

"Verily, Allah has revealed to me that you must be humble towards one another, so that no one oppresses another or boasts to another."

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2865; Riyad as-Salihin, Hadith 1589

**Narrated by:** Iyad ibn Himar (may Allah be pleased with him)

Allah Himself revealed this! Be humble! 💚

## 🌟 Who Goes to Paradise?

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Shall I tell you about the people of Paradise? Every person who is weak and humble, but if they swore an oath by Allah, He would fulfill it."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 4918; Sahih Muslim, Hadith 2853

**Narrated by:** Harithah ibn Wahb (may Allah be pleased with him)

Humble people = Paradise people! 🌈

## 💚 What is Humility?

Being humble means:
- Not thinking you're better than others ✅
- Being kind to everyone ✅
- Not showing off ✅
- Treating rich and poor the same ✅
- Admitting when you're wrong ✅
- Listening to others ✅
- Being simple, not fancy ✅

## 🌈 The Prophet's ﷺ Humility:

**1. He Did His Own Work! 🧹**

Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) said:

**"The Prophet ﷺ used to help his family with household chores. When prayer time came, he would go out to pray."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 676

The Prophet ﷺ cleaned, cooked, and helped at home! 🏠

**2. He Played With Children! 👶**

Anas (may Allah be pleased with him) said:

**"The Prophet ﷺ would greet children when he passed by them."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6247; Sahih Muslim

He didn't ignore kids - he talked to them! 😊

**3. He Accepted Small Gifts! 🎁**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"If I am invited to eat even a leg of meat, I will accept. If someone gives me a shoulder (small piece) as a gift, I will accept it."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari; Sahih Muslim

He accepted ANY gift, no matter how small! 💝

## 🎯 How to Be Humble:

**At Home:** 🏠
- Help with chores without being asked
- Don't demand special treatment
- Listen to your parents
- Be kind to siblings
- Share your things

**At School:** 📚
- Don't brag about your grades
- Help friends who struggle
- Don't think you're smarter than others
- Be friends with everyone, not just "cool" kids
- Thank your teachers

**Everywhere:** 🌍
- Greet everyone - young and old
- Don't show off your stuff
- Admit when you make mistakes
- Apologize when you're wrong
- Treat everyone with respect

## ⚠️ What is Pride (The Opposite)?

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever has even a tiny bit of pride in their heart will not enter Paradise."**

Someone asked: **"But what if someone likes to have nice clothes and shoes?"**

The Prophet ﷺ replied: **"Allah is Beautiful and loves beauty. Pride means rejecting the truth and looking down on people."**

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim

So pride = thinking you're better than others! That's very bad! 😢

## 💎 Signs You're Being Humble:

✅ You thank people who help you
✅ You don't interrupt when others speak
✅ You're happy when others succeed
✅ You help without expecting praise
✅ You don't brag about yourself
✅ You're kind to everyone
✅ You admit your mistakes

## 🌟 The Humility Challenge:

**This Week:**

☑️ **Day 1:** Help at home without being asked
☑️ **Day 2:** Compliment someone (not yourself!)
☑️ **Day 3:** Apologize for a mistake
☑️ **Day 4:** Listen to someone without interrupting
☑️ **Day 5:** Share credit with others
☑️ **Day 6:** Be kind to someone younger
☑️ **Day 7:** Thank everyone who helped you this week!

## 💚 Remember:

Allah says in the Quran:

**"The servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth in humility."** (Quran 25:63)

Being humble doesn't mean weak! It means STRONG enough to not need to show off!

The Prophet ﷺ was the most humble person EVER - and he was the GREATEST person EVER! 🌟

Let's be like him! Stay humble, stay blessed! 💚✨

*Parents: Model humility in daily life. Praise children for humble behavior. These hadiths from Bukhari and Muslim show that true greatness comes from humility!*

grow.title: 💚 Love for Others What You Love for Yourself!
grow.content:
Did you know? Your faith isn't complete until you love for others what you love for yourself! Let's learn this beautiful teaching! 🌟

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

**Translation:**

"None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 2 (Belief), Hadith 13; Sahih Muslim, Book 1 (Faith), Hadith 45

**Narrated by:** Anas ibn Malik (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 🌈 What Does This Mean?

Imagine you have a yummy cookie 🍪. You love it, right? This hadith teaches us to wish that our friends also have yummy cookies! 

It means:
- If you want good grades, want your friends to get good grades too! 📚
- If you love playing games, don't be selfish - share with others! 🎮
- If you have nice toys, wish others have nice toys too! 🧸
- If you're happy, want happiness for everyone! 😊

## 💚 Real-Life Examples:

**At School:**
✅ Your friend doesn't understand homework? Help them!
✅ You got a new pen? Share with someone who needs one!
✅ You know the answer? Help others learn it too!

**At Home:**
✅ Mom made your favorite food? Ask her to make enough for everyone!
✅ You got a gift? Think about your siblings too!
✅ You're comfortable? Make sure others are comfortable too!

**With Friends:**
✅ Found a cool game? Invite them to play!
✅ Learning something new? Teach your friends!
✅ Have extra snacks? Share them! 🍫

## ⭐ What NOT to Do:

❌ Getting jealous when your friend gets something nice
❌ Wanting to be the only one with good things
❌ Being happy when others fail or are sad
❌ Keeping all the good stuff for yourself

## 🎯 The Golden Rule:

**Before you do anything, ask yourself:**
"Would I want someone to do this TO me?"
- If YES → Go ahead! ✅
- If NO → Don't do it! ❌

## 💎 Beautiful Benefits:

**When you love for others what you love for yourself:**
1. Your faith (Iman) becomes complete! 💚
2. People will love you back! 🤗
3. Allah will be pleased with you! ✨
4. You'll have true friends! 👫
5. Everyone becomes happier! 🌈

## 🌟 Try This Week!

**Monday:** Share something you love with someone
**Tuesday:** Help a friend with something difficult
**Wednesday:** Make dua for someone to get what you want
**Thursday:** Give a compliment to someone
**Friday:** Invite someone to join your fun activity!

## 📝 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ taught us that good Muslims think about others, not just themselves! When you see someone sad, try to make them happy. When someone needs help, help them. When you have something good, share it!

This is TRUE brotherhood and sisterhood in Islam! 💚

*Parents: This hadith teaches children empathy, generosity, and thinking beyond themselves. Encourage them to practice this daily!*

grow.title: 💬 Every Good Word is Charity!
grow.content:
Guess what? You can give charity WITHOUT money! Just by saying nice words! Let's learn how! 😊

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ

**Translation:**

"A good word is charity (Sadaqah)."

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 2989; Sahih Muslim, Book 12 (Zakat), Hadith 1009

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 💚 What Are Good Words?

Good words are:
- Kind words that make people smile 😊
- Helpful words that teach people 📚
- Beautiful words that praise Allah 🤲
- Peaceful words that stop fights 🕊️
- Happy words that cheer people up 🌈

## 🌟 Examples of Good Words:

**Nice Things to Say:**
- "You did a great job!" ⭐
- "Thank you so much!" 🙏
- "I'm sorry, please forgive me" 💚
- "You look nice today!" 😊
- "Don't worry, I'll help you!" 🤝
- "You can do it!" 💪
- "Alhamdulillah!" (All praise is for Allah) ✨
- "May Allah bless you!" 🌟

**When Someone is Sad:**
- "It's okay, don't be sad!"
- "I'm here for you!"
- "Things will get better, InSha'Allah!"
- "Let me help you feel better!"

**When Someone Does Something Good:**
- "MashaAllah, that's amazing!"
- "I'm so proud of you!"
- "You're so smart!"
- "Great work!"

## ❌ Bad Words to AVOID:

- Mean words that hurt feelings 😢
- Lies that deceive people 🚫
- Gossip that spreads secrets 🤐
- Angry words that start fights 😤
- Curse words (never say these!) ❌

## 💎 The Amazing Reward:

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Every good word is charity!"**

This means:
- Say "Alhamdulillah" → Charity! ✅
- Tell your mom "I love you" → Charity! ✅
- Say "Sorry" → Charity! ✅
- Compliment your friend → Charity! ✅
- Say "As-Salamu Alaikum" → Charity! ✅

You can give charity ALL DAY LONG just by being nice! 🌟

## 🎯 The Word Challenge:

**Count Your Charity Words Today!**

Every time you say something nice, count it:
- Morning: 🌟🌟🌟 (3 good words!)
- Afternoon: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 (5 good words!)
- Evening: 🌟🌟🌟🌟 (4 good words!)

**Total: 12 charities just from words!** How cool is that? 🎉

## 📚 Another Beautiful Hadith:

The Prophet ﷺ also said:

**"Say what is good, or remain silent."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim

This means: If you can't say something nice, don't say anything! 🤐

## 🌈 Make Your Words Beautiful!

**Think Before You Speak:**
1. Is it TRUE? ✅
2. Is it KIND? ✅
3. Is it NECESSARY? ✅

If you answer YES to all three, then say it! If NO to any, keep quiet! 🤫

## 💚 Special Words to Say Every Day:

**Morning:** "Alhamdulillah for this new day!"
**When you eat:** "Bismillah" and "Alhamdulillah"
**To parents:** "I love you, JazakAllahu Khairan!"
**To friends:** "You're an amazing friend!"
**Before bed:** "Alhamdulillah for everything!"

## 🎁 Remember:

Your tongue is powerful! The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should speak good or remain silent."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6018; Sahih Muslim

So use your words to:
- Make people happy, not sad 😊
- Build people up, not tear them down 💪
- Spread love, not hate 💚
- Give charity, not hurt! 🌟

From today, let's be CHARITY WORD CHAMPIONS! Every nice word you say is a sadaqah! Start NOW! 💬✨

*Parents: Encourage positive speech at home. Praise children when they use kind words. This builds good character and earns continuous rewards!*

grow.title: 👴👵 Honor Your Elders - Earn Allah's Blessings!
grow.content:
Did you know? Respecting older people is SO important that the Prophet ﷺ said: "He is NOT one of us!" if we don't do it! Let's learn why! 👵👴

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ صَغِيرَنَا وَيُوَقِّرْ كَبِيرَنَا

**Translation:**

"He is not one of us who does not show mercy to our young ones and does not honor our elders."

**Reference:** Sunan Abu Dawud, Hadith 4943; Sunan At-Tirmidhi, Hadith 1919 (authenticated as Sahih)

**Narrated by:** Abdullah ibn Amr (may Allah be pleased with him)

## 🌟 Honoring Elders is Honoring Allah!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Part of glorifying Allah is to show respect to a grey-haired Muslim."**

**Reference:** Sunan Abu Dawud, Hadith 4843 (authenticated as Sahih)

**Narrated by:** Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (may Allah be pleased with him)

Wow! When you respect old people, you're actually respecting ALLAH! 💚

## 💎 Who Should Greet First?

The Prophet ﷺ taught us:

**"The young should greet the old."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Book 79 (Asking Permission), Hadith 6231

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

So YOU should say "As-Salamu Alaikum" to older people FIRST! Don't wait for them! 👋

## 🌈 How to Show Respect:

**1. In Speech: 💬**
- Say "As-Salamu Alaikum" first
- Speak politely and gently
- Don't raise your voice
- Listen when they talk
- Say "Yes, Uncle" or "Yes, Aunty"

**2. In Action: 🚶**
- Stand up when they enter the room
- Help them sit down
- Offer them your seat on the bus
- Help carry their bags
- Walk slowly if walking with them
- Open doors for them

**3. In Service: 🤲**
- Ask if they need anything
- Bring them water or food
- Help them with tasks
- Visit them when sick
- Make dua for them

## 🎯 Real-Life Examples:

**At Home:**
✅ When Grandma speaks, stop and listen
✅ Help Grandpa get up from his chair
✅ Greet elderly visitors warmly
✅ Don't argue or talk back

**At the Masjid:**
✅ Let elders go first in line
✅ Give them the best seats
✅ Help them with wudu if needed
✅ Greet them with a smile

**On the Street:**
✅ Help elders cross the road
✅ Give up your seat on the bus
✅ Hold the door open
✅ Don't rush past them

## 💚 Angel Jibril's Command!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Jibril (Angel Gabriel) kept commanding me to give priority to the elderly."**

**Reference:** Authenticated by Al-Albani

Even Angel Jibril kept reminding the Prophet ﷺ about this! That's how important it is! 😇

## 🌟 Let Elders Speak First!

Once, young people came to the Prophet ﷺ to ask questions. The youngest started talking first. The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Let the eldest (among you) speak first."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6828

So when with adults, let the older ones talk first! 💬

## ⚠️ Important Notes:

**Who Are "Elders"?**
- Your grandparents 👵👴
- Your parents (they're older than you!) 👨👩
- Your teachers and aunties/uncles
- Any older person - Muslim or non-Muslim!

**What NOT to Do:**
❌ Ignore elders when they speak
❌ Interrupt them
❌ Be rude or disrespectful
❌ Walk past without greeting
❌ Make fun of them
❌ Call them by their first name (say Uncle/Aunty)

## 🎁 The Blessings!

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Blessings are with your elders."**

**Reference:** Sahih Ibn Hibban, Hadith 559 (authenticated as Sahih by Al-Albani)

**Narrated by:** Ibn Abbas (may Allah be pleased with him)

This means when you respect elders, Allah sends blessings to you and your community! 🌟

## 🌈 Try This Week:

**Monday:** Greet 3 elderly people with "As-Salamu Alaikum"
**Tuesday:** Help an elder with something (carry bag, open door)
**Wednesday:** Visit your grandparents (or call them!)
**Thursday:** Give up your seat for an elderly person
**Friday:** Make special dua for all elders after prayer

## 💚 Remember:

The Prophet ﷺ said that if you don't respect elders, you're NOT really following Islam properly! 😢

But when you DO respect them:
- Allah is pleased with you! ✨
- You get LOTS of blessings! 🎁
- You're following the Prophet's way! 💚
- People will respect YOU when you're old! 🔄

So starting today, be the BEST at respecting elders! Say Salam, offer help, speak kindly, and watch the blessings flow! 🌟

*Parents: Model respectful behavior toward YOUR elders. Children learn by watching! This teaches them honor, humility, and the Islamic value of revering age and experience.*

grow.title: 🏘️ Be Kind to Your Neighbors!
grow.content:
Did you know? The Prophet ﷺ talked about neighbors SO much that he thought Angel Jibril would tell him to give them inheritance! Let's learn why neighbors are special! 🏠💚

## 📖 What the Prophet ﷺ Said:

**Arabic:**

مَا زَالَ جِبْرِيلُ يُوصِينِي بِالْجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ سَيُوَرِّثُهُ

**Translation:**

"Jibril kept recommending me to treat neighbors well until I thought he would tell me to make them heirs (give them inheritance)!"

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6014; Sahih Muslim

**Narrated by:** Ibn Umar and Aisha (may Allah be pleased with them)

## ⚠️ WARNING: Don't Harm Your Neighbor!

The Prophet ﷺ said (THREE times!):

**Arabic:**

وَاللَّهِ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ

**"By Allah, he is NOT a believer! By Allah, he is NOT a believer! By Allah, he is NOT a believer!"**

They asked: "Who, O Messenger of Allah?"

He said: **"One whose neighbor is not safe from his harm."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6016; Sahih Muslim

**Narrated by:** Abu Huraira (may Allah be pleased with him)

Wow! He said it THREE times! That's how serious it is! 😮

## 💚 Who is Your Neighbor?

**EVERYONE near you!**
- The houses next to yours (right and left)
- The houses in front and behind
- Up to 40 houses in each direction!
- Muslim OR non-Muslim - ALL are neighbors!

## 🌟 How to Be a GREAT Neighbor:

**1. Share Food! 🍲**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"O Abu Dharr! When you make broth, add extra water and give some to your neighbors."**

**Reference:** Sahih Muslim, Book 32, Hadith 2625

Even if it's something small - share it! 🥘

**2. Give Gifts! 🎁**

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"O Muslim women! Do not belittle any gift to your neighbor, even if it is a sheep's trotter (hoof)."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 6017; Sahih Muslim

Even tiny gifts matter! Never think "this is too small"! 💝

**3. Don't Make Noise! 🔇**
- Keep your TV volume low
- Don't shout and scream
- Be quiet at night
- Don't disturb them!

**4. Be Helpful! 🤝**
- Help carry their groceries
- Water their plants when they're away
- Check on them when sick
- Offer to help with tasks

**5. Be Friendly! 😊**
- Smile and greet them
- Say "As-Salamu Alaikum"
- Ask how they're doing
- Invite them over sometimes

## 🎯 Real-Life Neighbor Kindness:

**If your neighbor is:**

**Sick:** 🤒
- Visit them
- Bring food
- Ask if they need anything
- Make dua for them

**Having a party:** 🎉
- Be understanding about noise
- Maybe send a gift over
- If invited, accept!

**In trouble:** 😰
- Offer help
- Be supportive
- Protect their privacy
- Don't gossip about them

**Making food:** 🍽️
- If you smell delicious food, make dua for them!
- If they share with you, thank them!
- Share YOUR food too!

## 📏 Which Neighbor Comes First?

Aisha (may Allah be pleased with her) asked the Prophet ﷺ:

**"I have two neighbors. Which one should I give gifts to first?"**

He replied: **"The one whose door is closer to you."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith 2259

So the CLOSEST neighbor has the most rights! 🏠

## ⚠️ Things That Harm Neighbors:

❌ Making too much noise
❌ Blocking their driveway
❌ Letting your trash spill over
❌ Being rude or mean
❌ Gossiping about them
❌ Not greeting them
❌ Being selfish

## 💎 Beautiful Hadith:

The Prophet ﷺ said:

**"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should be kind to his neighbor."**

**Reference:** Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim
